text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain and Kuwait Bank's net profits rise to 7.2 million dinars in the first nine months of this year.
- Minister of labour and social affairs says important projects are to be announced soon to support training plans.
- A study on the insurance sector shows that Gulf States own 35 percent of the insurance industry in the Middle East.
- Prime minister to open "Wonder of Gold" exhibition on Monday.
- Kuwaiti newspaper urge Gulf States to convince Bahrain to attend next summit in Qatar.
- Labour and social affairs minister urges firms to widen their positive role in society.
- Five Bahrainis jailed for attack on tailor's shop.
